Download CropScape data

Source: R/source-cropscape.R
download_cropscape.Rd

Download annual USDA Cropland Data Layer archives from the USDA National Agricultural Statistics Service or George Mason University. Archives and extracted raster data are stored in separate subdirectories using the shared download workflow.

Usage

download_cropscape(
  year = seq(1997, 2023),
  source = c("GMU", "USDA"),
  directory_to_save = NULL,
  acknowledgement = FALSE,
  download = TRUE,
  remove_command = FALSE,
  unzip = TRUE,
  remove_zip = FALSE,
  hash = FALSE,
  show_progress = TRUE,
  max_tries = 20,
  rate_limit = 2
)

Arguments

year

integer(1 or more). One year, two endpoints, or a non-empty vector of years. Every year from the minimum through the maximum is requested, including gaps: c(2018, 2023) requests 2018:2023. Default is 1997:2023. Valid years run from 1997 for GMU or 2008 for USDA through the current calendar year, inclusive. Missing, fractional, or out-of-range years cause the entire request to raise an error before directory creation; years are not filtered or truncated.

source

character(1). Data source, either "GMU" (default) or "USDA". GMU requests use YYYY_cdls.tar.gz with a minimum year of 1997. USDA requests use YYYY_30m_cdls.zip with a minimum year of 2008; supply a compatible year when choosing USDA. File availability is determined by the selected provider.

directory_to_save

character(1). Non-empty parent directory. Archives are downloaded into zip_files/ and, when unzip = TRUE, extracted into separate per-archive directories under data_files/.

acknowledgement

logical(1). Must be TRUE to proceed. CropScape archives and extracted rasters can require substantial storage.

download

logical(1). Deprecated. FALSE warns and returns a preview after directory creation, without contacting the provider. No archives are downloaded or extracted in preview mode. Default is TRUE.

remove_command

logical(1). Deprecated and ignored; TRUE warns. No command file is generated. Default is FALSE.

unzip

logical(1). Extract downloaded .zip or .tar.gz archives into per-archive directories under data_files/. Default is TRUE; FALSE skips extraction and creation of the per-archive directories.

remove_zip

logical(1). Remove downloaded archives and their zip_files/ directory, including its remaining contents, after the extraction loop finishes. Default is FALSE; requires unzip = TRUE. Ignored when download = FALSE.

hash

logical(1). Return a combined MD5 hash of the files under data_files/ instead of the download summary. Default is FALSE. Ignored when download = FALSE.

show_progress

logical(1). Show file download progress. Default is TRUE. Other status messages may still be printed when FALSE.

max_tries

integer(1). Maximum attempts per file download request, including the initial attempt. Default is 20.

rate_limit

numeric(1). Non-negative throttling interval in seconds, passed to download_run_method(). Default is 2.

Value

With download = FALSE, an invisible preview list containing urls, destfiles, and n_files. Otherwise, after downloading and optional extraction, hash = FALSE returns the download summary from download_run_method() invisibly. With hash = TRUE, returns a visible character scalar containing the combined MD5 hash of data_files/.

The download summary always contains success, failed, skipped, failed_urls, and failed_files. The two failure vectors are character(0) when no files failed, including when every file was skipped.

Details

zip_files/ and data_files/ are sibling directories created beneath directory_to_save, including for previews and when unzip = FALSE. Both ZIP and compressed TAR downloads are stored in zip_files/. Each archive is extracted into its own directory under data_files/, named after the archive with the full .zip or .tar.gz suffix removed: data_files/YYYY_30m_cdls/ for USDA and data_files/YYYY_cdls/ for GMU. This isolates duplicate filenames across archives. Paths stored inside each archive are preserved. Pass the corresponding per-archive directory or an extracted TIFF path to process_cropscape().

Preview destinations refer to the archive files in zip_files/. Actual downloads use download_run_method(), which skips existing non-empty archives and records individual download failures. Existing archives are still passed to extraction when unzip = TRUE.

Hashing covers all files recursively under data_files/, including the per-archive subdirectories and existing files, and excludes archives in zip_files/. With unzip = FALSE, hashing still uses data_files/, which may be empty or contain previously extracted data.

See also

download_setup_dir(), download_unzip(), process_cropscape()

Author

Insang Song

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
download_cropscape(
  year = 2020,
  source = "GMU",
  directory_to_save = file.path(tempdir(), "cropscape"),
  acknowledgement = TRUE,
  download = FALSE # Preview archive URLs and zip_files/ destinations.
)
} # }
